shortDescription: Manage logs destination that serves as a sync point for logs data. You need read_write access to the scope to call this operation.

options.name: details
options.description: Settings for the destination. For type 'akamai_object_storage': provide access_key_id, access_key_secret, bucket_name, host and optionally path. For type 'custom_https': provide authentication, client_certificate_details, content_type, data_compression, endpoint_url and optionally custom_headers.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier assigned to the logs destination. Run the List logs destinations operation and store the id for the applicable logs destination. Required for updating.

options.name: label
options.description: The name of the destination object. Used for display purposes.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of destination for log data sync, either akamai_object_storage if Object Storage is the destination, or custom_https for a unique URL

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the logs destination ready.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for the logs destination.
